acceptedAnswer.text: We are a software house in Lahore building websites, web apps, mobile apps, full-stack products and AI solutions, plus design, support and SEO.

name: Who will work on my project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our own team of four. You talk directly to the people building your product, not a middle layer.

name: Do you work with clients outside Pakistan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We work worldwide and communicate by email, WhatsApp and video calls.

name: I am not technical. Is that a problem?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not at all. We explain everything in plain language and guide you at every step.

name: How much does a project cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on what you need. See our pricing packages for starting points, then request a free, fixed quote.
Usually a deposit to start, a payment at a middle milestone and the balance on launch. We agree the plan in writing first.

name: How long will my project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A simple website takes two to three weeks. Apps and larger systems take longer. You get a clear timeline before we start. See our process.

name: Can I see progress while you build?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We share working demos and updates regularly so you can give feedback early.
Yes. Small changes during the project are welcome. Bigger changes are discussed and agreed with you before we start them.

name: Do you offer support after launch?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Every package includes a free support period, and monthly support plans are available after that.

name: Who owns the code and the website?

acceptedAnswer.text: You do, once the project is paid for. We hand over the code, designs and account access.

name: My site is already built. Can you improve it?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We review it, tell you honestly what to keep, and then fix, extend or rebuild it.
